maya: Quick brain-dump: shipping a tiny "branch guardian" runtime to manage canary/A-B + automatic fallback. Proposal: three roles - Gate (traffic split), Probe (health/signals), Operator (make changes). Keep it composable.

priya: Sounds good. One immediate question: where is the source of truth for who owns traffic slices? central control plane vs local router?

dave: We should avoid going fully central for latency reasons. Suggest hybrid: signed policy manifest from control plane + local policy engine that can act autonomously for a short window (autonomy_window_s). If control plane reachable, it reconciles and can push overrides.

maya: Exactly. Manifest pinning: each router caches last-signed manifest + manifest_version. If manifest signature invalid or expired, router falls back to safe_manifest.

alex: Operator contract idea: POST /agent/v1/operator/apply -> {op_id, revert_token, ttl_s}. Revert is POST /agent/v1/operator/revert with revert_token. Enforce idempotency and opaque revert tokens so actions are auditable.

ops-bot: deploybot: rolling canary for ranking-model started 2026-03-24T09:10Z, slice=3%

priya: Hybrid tradeoffs: local autonomy reduces reaction time but can cause two nodes to make conflicting decisions. Need deterministic reconciliation rules. Maybe a reconciliation ledger where nodes append compact ops (op_id, manifest_version, timestamp) to central aggregator when connectivity exists.

dave: +1. Also we need an override lease API: POST /agent/v1/override {manifest_version, expires_at, reason}. Routers accept overrides only if signed and lease not expired. If control plane disappears, lease expiry ensures we don't permanently override local safety.

maya: For split-brain reconciliation, define heuristics: last-write-wins on op timestamps with tie-breaker by node-id, and never auto-merge conflicting rollbacks - surface to ops console for manual resolution.

alex: Metrics to emit: operator_apply_latency_seconds, operator_revert_attempts_total, operator_conflict_resolutions_total, gate_current_slice_percent. Alerts: operator_conflict_resolutions_total > 0 for 1m -> page.

priya: Policy API surface: evaluate(manifest_version, local_signals) -> {action: allow|scale_down|drain, confidence, op_hint}. Keep evaluation deterministic and stateless (no local DB).

dave: Long-term: replace ad-hoc gate rules with a typed policy language so we can unit-test static properties (safety invariants) before pushing. Also add a small policy linter in CI.

maya: Dev plan: RFC with diagrams, sample HTTP contracts, sequence flows for apply/revert, signed-manifest lifecycle, and reconciliation ledger sketch. Add a tiny chaos harness: partition control-plane for N minutes and assert routers respect autonomy_window and then reconcile.

priya: Operational defaults proposal: autonomy_window_s=300, override_lease_s=180, default_revert_ttl_s=300. Make them configurable per-tenant.

dave: Add operator sandbox mode (dry-run) that emits what it would do to logs/metrics without changing traffic. Useful during rollout of new policies.

maya: Nice. I'll open RFC + TODO checklist. Please add test cases for staggered clock skew and ensure revert_token TTL logic is safe across time drift.
